title: पहिला पाऊस
body:
मातीचा गंध दरवळला,
आभाळ हळूच झुकले,
आठवणींचे थेंब
ओंजळीत साठले.

title: संध्याकाळ
body:
दिव्याची एक ज्योत,
अंगणात उतरली शांतता,
दिवसभराच्या धावपळीला
मिळाली हक्काची कविता.

title: The River Waits
body:
The river does not hurry,
it has learned the art of staying.
What it carries, it carries lightly —
what it leaves, it leaves as light.

title: Unfinished Colours
body:
Some mornings arrive unfinished,
terracotta bleeding into grey.
I do not correct them.
I let the canvas say what I cannot.
